mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EMP SET EMP_PW = #{passwordHash}, MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD = FALSE, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: UPDATE TB_EMP SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1, LOCKED_UNTIL = CASE WHEN (FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1) % 5 = 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 minute' ELSE LOCKED_UNTIL END, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE HOSP_DIV_ID = #{hospitalId} AND EMP_ID = #{userId} RETURNING FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EMP SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE HOSP_DIV_ID = #{hospitalId} AND EMP_ID = #{userId} AND (FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT != 0 OR LOCKED_UNTIL IS NOT NULL)
